verdict.rationale: Digits documents an in-product AI financial assistant, Ask Digits, that answers questions about cash flow, expenses, revenue trends, vendor history, budgets, and forecasts. It also documents trend insights, AI transaction flagging with smart reviews, and exceptions surfaced with context during the Agentic Close. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, and fuller documentation of proactive suggestions beyond brief marketing mentions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Ask Digits anything about your financials—cash flow, expenses, revenue trends, vendor history, budgets, or forecasts—and get clear, accurate answers in seconds
Ask Digits Your AI financial assistant
cash flow and runway tracking, trend insights, and collaborative tools
Digits AI learns your business to provide 24/7 bookkeeping with transaction flagging & smart reviews
Surfaces exceptions with context on what was attempted and why
